ps23-1.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

php4-13.text: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.

ps46-1.text: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.

rom12-12.text: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.

php4-4.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

ps100-5.text: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.

jhn14-27.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

1th5-18.text: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

1co13-13.text: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.

ps23-2.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.

rom12-21.text: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

php4-6.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

ps100-2.text: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.

jhn14-18.text: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

ps23-3.text: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.

rom12-15.text: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.

php4-7.text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

1th5-24.text: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.

ps100-4.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.

rom12-18.text: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.

jhn14-15.text: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

1co13-4.text: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

ps46-10.text: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”

php4-19.text: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.

1th5-11.text: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.

ps100-1.text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.

rom12-9.text: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.

ps23-4.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

1th5-21.text: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.

jhn3-16.text: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.

rom12-10.text: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.

ps100-3.text: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

luk2-10.text: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:

luk2-11.text: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!

luk2-14.text: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!”

isa9-2.text: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.

isa9-6.text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
